proposal.reason: Main change is end-to-end CollNet removal from transport/plugin/proxy connection and loading paths. Additional substantive work removes CollNet device-kernel implementations while keeping a reserved algorithm slot, removes CollNet topology graph construction/search/connection, updates built-in algorithm/protocol tuning to keep slot 2 disabled, and hardens external tuner v1 integration by rejecting CollNet/out-of-range selections and falling back to internal tuning.
